title: Eligibility Criteria for Learning Higher Mother Tongue in Primary Schools
what_it_is: Eligibility Criteria for Learning Higher Mother Tongue in Primary Schools

sections.label: Higher Mother Tongue curriculum design
sections.summary: The Higher Mother Tongue curriculum stretches students with keen ability and strong interest, and schools consider both interest and ability.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: The Higher Mother Tongue curriculum is designed to stretch students who have a keen ability and strong interest in the language.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: In their consideration of Higher Mother Tongue, schools take into consideration both the interest and the ability of the students.

sections.label: HCL curriculum for SAP schools
sections.summary: The HCL curriculum was developed at the lower primary levels to support the needs of 15 Special Assistance Plan primary schools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The HCL curriculum was developed at the lower primary levels to support the needs of our Special Assistance Plan (SAP) primary schools, of which we have 15 currently.

sections.label: Two criteria for HCL
sections.summary: The two key criteria for taking up HCL are strong interest and keen ability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Allow me to reiterate that the two key criteria are strong interest and keen ability in taking up HCL.

sections.label: St Hilda's Primary HCL class
sections.summary: St Hilda's Primary School had an unusually high cut-off mark, reviewed its criteria with MOE guidance, and will open another HCL class.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In the case of St Hilda's Primary School, the cut-off mark was unusually high, as the school sought to ensure a high level of ability in the students who wanted to take HCL.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: With feedback and guidance from MOE, the school has very quickly reviewed its criteria and will be opening another HCL class to cater to the growing desire for HCL.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: MOE is very glad that the school is taking positive steps very swiftly to enlarge its pool of HCL students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The broader point is that it really reflects the school's commitment in terms of the teaching and learning of the Mother Tongue language, not just Chinese language but all three Mother Tongue languages.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This is why, other than the MOE curriculum, we also have the three Mother Tongue languages promotion committees to supplement the efforts on the ground.
